description: Declaration-only serial peer with two stop bits. The host's serial driver encodes and decodes 8n1/8e1/8o1 only, so this shape is refused by name by the declaration layer and never narrowed to one stop bit.
notes: this is a schema example, not a pinned device declaration: no UART scenario references it
frame 8n2 is one start bit, eight data bits and two stop bits; the host's frame word has one stop position, so the extra bit time would be silently dropped if this declaration ran
the refusal is unsupported-behavior-value:pin_groups.frame, raised where the frame value is checked, before any model is built
